items.title: Officials give Jameis Winston a TD, replays appear to show he was down before scoring
items.text: The officials gave Giants quarterback Jameis Winston a touchdown on a fourth-and-goal tush push today against the Jaguars, but on replay it's not at all clear that Winston actually scored.

items.title: Officials deny Jaguars TD on sensational catch by Parker Washington
items.text: Washington appeared to make a superb touchdown catch, but the officials and the replay office ruled it incomplete.

items.text: The NFC East leaders surprised the AFC South leaders today.

items.title: Liam Coen: I was told ball switched hands on Parker Washington catch
items.text: The Giants held off the Jaguars on Sunday, but the outcome might have been different if referees had made a different ruling on a pass to Jaguars wideout Parker Washington early in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Liam Coen: Everything said kick FG late in fourth, going for it a "hope play"
items.text: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen opted to kick a field goal from the 9-yard-line and cut the Giants' lead to 23-18 with just over three minutes to play in Sunday's game, but hopes of winning the game with a touchdown went up in smoke when the Giants picked up two first downs and ran out the clock.

items.title: NFL says Parker Washington didn't control ball until he was out of bounds
items.text: Sunday's game between the Jaguars and Giants included a controversial decision in the fourth quarter on a play that looked like a touchdown catch by Jacksonville receiver Parker Washington.

items.title: Jets beat Chargers 27-24 to end five-game losing streak
items.text: The Jets scored on their first five possessions and then ran out the clock on the Chargers from there.
